attempts.summary: Established a site-to-site IPsec tunnel between VyOS (node1) and OPNsense (node2) carrying lan-a (10.10.1.0/24, node3) and lan-b (10.10.2.0/24, node4) over the transit network (10.10.3.0/24). Configured static addressing on the four routed interfaces, static routes on node3/node4, an IKEv2 tunnel (AES256/SHA256/MODP2048, PSK auth) using each vendor's native config surface (VyOS `set vpn ipsec` CLI; OPNsense config.xml Swanctl/IPsec model plus enc0 pseudo-interface registration and firewall pass rules), and verified encrypted end-to-end reachability between node3 and node4's private addresses. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery (interfaces, IPsec SA, firewall, cross-tunnel ping) at each step.
